biotools.summary: sci-L3Pipe is a software pipeline for single-cell combinatorial indexing with linear amplification, enabling high-throughput sequencing of various modalities like genome conformation capture and RNA/chromatin accessibility. The pipeline builds upon the sci-L3 method, extending it to new applications with minimal modifications.
